title: Debuggable application
description: The application is marked android:debuggable=true, which allows attaching a debugger and inspecting or manipulating the running process on any device.
remediation: Set android:debuggable=false (the default) in release builds and rely on build-type overrides for development.

title: Application backup enabled
description: android:allowBackup=true permits application data to be extracted through adb backup, which may expose sensitive local data.
remediation: Set android:allowBackup=false or define a fullBackupContent/dataExtractionRules policy that excludes sensitive data.

title: Cleartext traffic enabled
description: android:usesCleartextTraffic=true allows the app to send unencrypted HTTP traffic, exposing it to interception and tampering.
remediation: Disable cleartext traffic and use a network security configuration that enforces TLS for all domains.

title: Exported component without permission
description: A component is reachable by other applications (explicitly exported or exported via an intent-filter) and is not guarded by an android:permission, so any app can interact with it.
remediation: Set android:exported=false if external access is unnecessary, or protect the component with a signature-level permission and validate all incoming input.

title: Exported ContentProvider
description: A ContentProvider is exported without a permission guard, potentially exposing backing databases or files to other applications.
remediation: Set android:exported=false, or require read/write permissions and enforce URI-permission grants with strict path validation.
